acAutoBoot.note: Boards whose EC powers the machine on when a power source is attached while 0x726 bit 3 is set. No EC byte announces this, so the names are those the Linux drivers list (tuxedo-drivers is_auto_boot_and_powershare_supported, mainline uniwill-laptop), plus X6AR55xY, whose EC 77.0 image was read for this project. A name matches a baseboard that contains it as a whole word, in any case.
